meta.name: conductor-feature-prepare
meta.description: Context artifacts preparation orchestrator — generates all context artifacts (module models, HTML mockups, technical specifications, test specifications) by invoking the appropriate sub-skills, tracking progress in a PREPARE_MASTER.md file for cross-session resumption. Takes an application name (mandatory), with optional version and module filters. Version supports single version, comma-separated list, "all", or omit for all versions. When multiple versions are resolved, they are processed SEQUENTIALLY in ascending semver order — all artifacts for version N are fully generated before version N+1 begins. Use this skill when the user asks to "prepare artifacts", "generate context", "prepare for development", "generate models and specs", "create mockups and specs", or any request to systematically generate all context artifacts from user stories before implementation begins. Also trigger when user says "resume preparation" to continue from where a previous session left off.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically generate module models, mockups, and specs before development.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按顺序生成指定应用的所有版本所需的上下文工件：模块模型、HTML 原型、技术规格和测试规格。它会自动启动循环，确保所有工件完整生成，并在中断后从中断处继续。
howto.when: 当你要求“准备工件”、“生成上下文”、“准备开发”、“生成模型和规格”、“创建原型和规格”，或要求从之前中断处“恢复准备”时触发。

say.text: 准备 mainapp 的上下文工件
say.note: Claude 会开始生成所有工件。
Claude 会从上次中断处继续。

say.text: 为 mainapp 版本 v2 生成模型和规格
say.note: Claude 只处理 v2 版本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude sequentially generates all context artifacts (module models, HTML mockups, technical specs, test specs) for each version of the specified app. It auto-starts a loop to ensure completeness and resumes from where it left off if interrupted.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "prepare artifacts", "generate context", "prepare for development", "generate models and specs", "create mockups and specs", or "resume preparation".

say_en.note: Claude will start generating all artifacts.
Claude will continue from where it left off.

say_en.text: Generate models and specs for mainapp version v2
